about: Local governments whose public meeting agendas Civic Accord reads automatically. Each entry is one government. Agendas come straight from the government's own public agenda system; nothing is written or reworded. Add a government by adding one entry with a source for each field. The first two pilots (Legistar) were chosen because their agenda systems offer public data with no key needed, and because they test a county (Maui County, Hawaiʻi) and a city (Oakland, California). Eagle, Idaho (Granicus) and Nevada, Missouri (CivicPlus) were added to test the readers for those systems.
